name: Point Cloud Simplification via Voxel-based Probabilistic Sub-sampling
definition: Reduces point cloud density by grouping points into a 3D grid and probabilistically selecting a fixed number of points per voxel.
summary: Point Cloud Simplification via Voxel-based Probabilistic Sub-sampling reduces point cloud density by probabilistically selecting points per voxel, preserving statistical distribution while enforcing strict capacity limits.
